name: xiaomistore.com.gt
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But buttons must have discernible text.
lesson: Give every button text or an aria-label, so a screen reader can announce it.
summary: xiaomistore.com.gt scores 66 out of 100 (D). 9 checks fail now, 30 are at risk, and 29 pass. Fix first: 108 form controls have no label.

fix.title: 108 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /, /collections/celulares, /collections/wearables, /collections/hogar-inteligente and 16 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: Buttons must have discernible text
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 10 elements on /collections/celulares, /collections/wearables, for example button[data-col="3"][data-breakpoint="desktop"][data-btn-as-a=""] and .is--active[data-col="4"][data-breakpoint="desktop"]. Impact: critical.
fix.fix: Give each icon button visible text or an aria-label.

fix.title: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 54 elements on /, /collections/celulares, /collections/wearables, for example .t4s-btn-style and #b_tab_item_UyekfV > span > .t4s-text-title. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Darken the text or lighten the background until normal text reaches 4.5:1 and large text 3:1.

fix.title: Links must have discernible text
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 51 elements on /, /collections/celulares, /collections/wearables, for example .t4s-site-nav__search > a[href$="search"][data-drawer-options="{ \"id\": \"#t4s-search-hidden\" }"][data-drawer-delay-=" and…
fix.fix: Give each link text, or an aria-label when it only holds an icon.

fix.title: ARIA hidden element must not be focusable or contain focusable elements
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 12 elements on /, for example #b_f9b8b909-6b31-45c2-b831-5b3090ac1662 and #b_image_parent_mBfrkJ. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Remove focusable elements from aria-hidden containers, or drop aria-hidden.

fix.title: <li> elements must be contained in a <ul> or <ol>
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 10 elements on /, for example .t4s_se_template--27922139971901__tabs_collection_7ynQtr > .t4s-tabs-se.t4s-tabs-underline.t4s-tabs-center > .t4s-tabs.t and .t4s_se_template--27922139971901__tabs_collection_7ynQtr >…
fix.fix: Put each li inside a ul or ol.
